definition_quote.value: an individual who assists an anesthesiologist in developing and implementing anesthesia care plans for patients
definition_quote.quote: "Anesthesiologist assistant" means an individual who assists an anesthesiologist in developing and implementing anesthesia care plans for patients.

value: Obtain a comprehensive patient history and present the history to the supervising anesthesiologist
Pretest and calibrate anesthesia delivery systems and monitor and obtain and interpret information from the systems and monitors
Assist the supervising anesthesiologist with the implementation of medically accepted monitoring techniques
Establish basic and advanced airway interventions, including intubation of the trachea and performing ventilatory support
Administer intermittent vasoactive drugs and start and adjust vasoactive infusions
Administer anesthetic drugs, adjuvant drugs, and accessory drugs
Assist the supervising anesthesiologist with the performance of epidural anesthetic procedures and spinal anesthetic procedures
Administer blood, blood products, and supportive fluids
methods_authorized.quote: an anesthesiologist assistant may assist the supervising anesthesiologist in developing and implementing an anesthesia care plan for a patient. In providing assistance to the supervising anesthesiologist, an anesthesiologist assistant may do any of the following

drug_authority.value: May administer anesthetic drugs, adjuvant drugs, accessory drugs, intermittent vasoactive drugs, and vasoactive infusions; may administer blood, blood products, and supportive fluids under direct supervision of a supervising anesthesiologist
drug_authority.quote: Administer intermittent vasoactive drugs and start and adjust vasoactive infusions; Administer anesthetic drugs, adjuvant drugs, and accessory drugs

supervising_anesthesiologist_physical_pr.quote: An anesthesiologist assistant shall practice only under the direct supervision and in the immediate presence of a physician who is actively and directly engaged in the clinical practice of medicine as an anesthesiologist.

written_practice_protocol_required.quote: Each anesthesiologist who agrees to act as the supervising anesthesiologist of an anesthesiologist assistant shall adopt a written practice protocol that is consistent with section 4760.09 of the Revised Code and delineates the services that the anesthesiologist assistant is authorized to provide and the manner in which the anesthesiologist will supervise the anesthesiologist assistant.

practice_setting_restrictions.quote: An anesthesiologist assistant shall not practice in any location other than a hospital or ambulatory surgical facility.

supervising_anesthesiologist_qualificati.quote: "Anesthesiologist" means a physician who has successfully completed an approved anesthesiology training program, as specified in the accreditation requirements that must be met to qualify as graduate medical education, as defined in section 4731.04 of the Revised Code.

hospital_or_facility_credentialing_autho.quote: Within thirty days after the imposition of any formal disciplinary action taken by any health care facility, including a hospital, health care facility operated by a health insuring corporation, ambulatory surgical facility, or similar facility, against any individual holding a valid license to practice as an anesthesiologist assistant, the chief administrator or executive officer of the facility shall report to the state medical board
